root_cause: When the Escape key is pressed, the dropdown's hide() method correctly closes the menu and updates aria-expanded, but it does not restore focus to the toggle button, causing focus to be lost (e.g., moved to the body).
repair_strategy: Modify the hide() method in the Dropdown class to move focus back to the toggle element (_element) after completing the hide operation.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape will close the actions menu and return focus to the 'Invoice actions' toggle button, satisfying keyboard operability requirements (WCAG 2.1.1, 2.4.3).
functional_risks: Programmatic calls to hide() will now shift focus to the toggle, which may be unexpected in some contexts.
If the toggle is disabled or detached, focusing could throw an error; however the method already checks isDisabled and visibility.
verification_requirements: Verify that Escape key closes the menu and focus returns to the toggle.
Verify that clicking outside the menu still closes it without unwanted focus shifts.
Verify that keyboard navigation (ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Enter) within the menu continues to work as expected.
Verify that the menu's open/close state and aria-expanded attribute are updated correctly.
